subject: Stage sweep: stakeholder brief, materials & review timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage sweep: stakeholder brief, materials & review timeline

Team —

We have the monthly pipeline sweep for Acme Health next week and I want to lock down who owns the stage updates and what goes into the leadership brief. High level asks:

- Please use the attached stage-update-template.xlsx and add one-line status + commit rationale for any deal in Commit/Forecasted Commit by EOD Wednesday (9/15).
- Markus: can you own the commit rollup CSV and make sure ASP / ARR buckets are reconciled vs. HubSpot?
- Grace: please curate the top 8 deals we should escalate to the leadership packet and add a short risk note in the template.
- Karthik: confirm whether any deals need an SLA exception or separate procurement coordination — call these out in column G.

External asks: I copied Sarah from Acme to confirm their internal calendar and any procurement gating they expect. Sarah — quick note on whether 9/22 for the leadership readout works on your side?

Deliverables & timeline:
- Wed 9/15 EOD: templates filled (all internal)
- Thu 9/16 AM: internal triage sync (30m) to resolve discrepancies
- Fri 9/17 EOD: leadership briefing packet assembled and sent to execs

Attachments: stage-update-template.xlsx (please do not rename), leadership-briefing-notes.md (skeleton for the exec slides).

Thanks — keep it lean.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage sweep: stakeholder brief, materials & review timeline

Vanessa — thanks. I started a CSV (commit-rollup-csv.csv) and reconciled HubSpot ARR against our forecast model for deals in Commit. Two quick notes inline:

> - Please use the attached stage-update-template.xlsx and add one-line status + commit rationale for any deal in Commit/Forecasted Commit by EOD Wednesday (9/15).

Done for 18 deals so far; I flagged four with mixed close dates where Acme has requested extended procurement review.

> - Markus: can you own the commit rollup CSV and make sure ASP / ARR buckets are reconciled vs. HubSpot?

Reconciled. I added a "data-confidence" column (high/medium/low) — medium shows where ACME payment terms or SOW scoping are still open.

Attachment: commit-rollup-csv.csv (columns: deal_id, hs_deal_id, ARR, ASP_bucket, close_date, data_confidence, notes)

I also included a short comment in the template for deal ACME-154 that needs pricing approval (see notes). Will be at the triage sync Thu AM.

- Markus

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 12:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage sweep: stakeholder brief, materials & review timeline

Thanks Vanessa — I've pulled the top 8 deals and added a one-paragraph risk note for each in the template (column: leadership_risk_note). Quick highlights:

- ACME-154: pricing approval needed, medium risk, procurement loop-in required (Markus noted).
- ACME-162: technical pilot dependency, recommended to move to "Negotiation" unless pilot confirmed by 9/20.
- ACME-171: Exec sponsor confirmed, high likelihood, low risk.

I'll present the short one-pagers at the triage sync and can draft the 1-slide summary per deal for the leadership packet.

Grace

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage sweep: stakeholder brief, materials & review timeline

Vanessa / team — thanks for the heads up. 9/22 is tight on our side for a leadership readout; can we aim for 9/24 instead? Procurement has an internal gating window the week of 9/20.

I've attached the procurement checklist our team uses (sent as a stub reference in this thread). Also: we can sign an SLA acknowledgement via DocuSign once the leadership packet is finalized. I'll have procurement@acmehealth.com confirm the gating items by Wed 9/15.

—Sarah
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Acme Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage sweep: stakeholder brief, materials & review timeline

Appreciate the fast turn. Quick updates after internal triage this morning:

- Timeline shift accepted: leadership readout moved to 9/24 per Acme's procurement window. New internal deadline for the packet: Mon 9/20 EOD so we have two days to iterate.
- Markus: please surface any low-confidence deals for removal from the commit number in the packet (we'll call them out visually).
- Grace: convert your one-paragraph notes into single-slide callouts for the top 6 (not 8) deals — leadership prefers tight focus.
- Karthik: if any deal triggers an SLA exception, please provide the wording we'll present to Acme procurement for the DocuSign.

Attachments: leadership-briefing-notes.md (updated outline with new deadlines), stage-update-template.xlsx (latest version).

I'll assemble the packet Monday morning and route to Laura for final deck formatting. Thanks all — let's keep comms terse this week so we can move quickly.

—Vanessa
